newsitem.title: CHINA: China Inner Mongolia coal mine to start in October.
newsitem.headline: China Inner Mongolia coal mine to start in October.

text.p: The first phase of an open-pit coal mine in China's northern region of Inner Mongolia is to start operation in October after seven years of construction, the Market Daily said on Wednesday.
The first phase of the Heidaigou mine in the middle of the huge Jungar coal field had coal reserves of about 1.5 billion tonnes and would produce 12 million tonnes of coal a year, the newspaper said.
Most coal produced by the mine would be low in sulphur and phosphorus and thus suitable for power generation, it said.
The Jungar coal field was the biggest open coal mine in China, it said but gave no further details.
